name: answer-feedback-browser

on:

      - src/answer-order.mjs
      - src/app.mjs
      - data/deck.json
      - demo.html

      - docs/receiving/answer-feedback-ab529ac65023/literal-deck.json
      - tools/check_answer_feedback_browser.mjs
      - .github/workflows/answer-feedback-browser.yml
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - index.html
      - styles.css
      - src/knowledge.mjs
      - src/review.mjs
      - src/reflections.mjs
      - src/deck.mjs
      - src/deck-picker.mjs

      - src/trace-archive-ui.mjs
      - src/lesson-archive.mjs
      - src/lesson-archive-ui.mjs
      - src/answer-order.mjs
      - src/app.mjs
      - data/deck.json
      - demo.html

      - docs/receiving/answer-feedback-ab529ac65023/literal-deck.json
      - tools/check_answer_feedback_browser.mjs
      - .github/workflows/answer-feedback-browser.yml

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  real-browser:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      # Keep the existing workflows intact and use their pinned action identities.
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: "22"
      - name: Check maintained receiver syntax
        run: node --check tools/check_answer_feedback_browser.mjs
      - name: Verify the committed standalone learner
        run: |
          python3 tools/make_demo.py
          git diff --exit-code -- demo.html
      - name: Receive visible answer identities with installed Chrome
        run: |
          chrome_bin="$(command -v google-chrome)"
          "$chrome_bin" --version
          node tools/check_answer_feedback_browser.mjs --root "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" --browser "$chrome_bin" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/answer-feedback-receiving" --emit-bundle

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  receive-handout:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 8
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4, inherited project pin
      - name: Require cached Node 22 and an installed system browser
        id: native
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          HANDOUT_NODE_VERSION=
          for HANDOUT_NODE_DIR in "${RUNNER_TOOL_CACHE}/node"/22.*; do
            if [[ -x "${HANDOUT_NODE_DIR}/x64/bin/node" && -f "${HANDOUT_NODE_DIR}/x64.complete" ]]; then
              HANDOUT_NODE_VERSION="${HANDOUT_NODE_DIR##*/}"
            fi
          done
          [[ -n "${HANDOUT_NODE_VERSION}" ]] || { echo "A complete cached Node 22 is required; no runtime will be installed."; exit 1; }
          printf 'node=%s\n' "${HANDOUT_NODE_VERSION}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
          HANDOUT_BROWSER=
          for HANDOUT_BROWSER_NAME in google-chrome google-chrome-stable chromium chromium-browser; do
            if command -v "${HANDOUT_BROWSER_NAME}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
              HANDOUT_BROWSER="$(command -v "${HANDOUT_BROWSER_NAME}")"
              break
            fi
          done
          [[ -n "${HANDOUT_BROWSER}" ]] || { echo "An installed Chrome/Chromium is required; no browser will be installed."; exit 1; }
          printf 'browser=%s\n' "${HANDOUT_BROWSER}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
          "${HANDOUT_BROWSER}" --version
          command -v python3
          if command -v pdftotext >/dev/null 2>&1; then pdftotext -v; else echo "pdftotext unavailable; PDF artifacts require separate direct inspection."; fi
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4, inherited project pin
        with:
          node-version: ${{ steps.native.outputs.node }}
      - name: Install and identify the standard CJK print font
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install --yes --no-install-recommends fonts-noto-cjk
          dpkg-query -W -f='${binary:Package} ${Version}\n' fonts-noto-cjk
          command -v fc-match
          HANDOUT_JP_FONT_FAMILY="$(fc-match --format='%{family}\n' 'sans-serif:lang=ja')"
          HANDOUT_JP_FONT_FILE="$(fc-match --format='%{file}\n' 'sans-serif:lang=ja')"
          printf 'Japanese font family: %s\nJapanese font file: %s\n' "${HANDOUT_JP_FONT_FAMILY}" "${HANDOUT_JP_FONT_FILE}"
          [[ "${HANDOUT_JP_FONT_FAMILY}" == *"Noto Sans CJK JP"* ]]
          [[ -f "${HANDOUT_JP_FONT_FILE}" ]]
          dpkg-query -S -- "${HANDOUT_JP_FONT_FILE}"
          sha256sum -- "${HANDOUT_JP_FONT_FILE}"
      - name: Receive actual studio, file selection, separate downloads and print artifacts
        run: node tools/check_course_handout_browser.mjs --browser "${{ steps.native.outputs.browser }}" --output "${RUNNER_TEMP}/course-handout-receiving"
      - name: Verify the direct-open teacher page matches its modular sources
        run: python3 tools/make_handout.py --check
      - name: Preserve bounded original browser and print artifacts
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4, verified from the official tag
        with:
          name: course-handout-receiving-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/course-handout-receiving
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14
          compression-level: 6

name: Actions pin drift

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: ['**']
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/**'
      - 'tools/actions_pin_drift.py'
      - 'tests/test_actions_pin_drift.py'
  schedule:
    - cron: '37 5 * * *'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  observe:
    if: github.repository == 'Jacob-Met/hamon'
    runs-on: [self-hosted, macOS, ARM64, hamon-mac]
    timeout-minutes: 10
    env:
      PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: '1'
      PYTHONNOUSERSITE: '1'
      PYTHONOPTIMIZE: '0'
    steps:
      - name: Check out the exact event source
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 1
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Prepare isolated parser and qualify the monitor
        id: qualify
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          HAPD_DIR=$(mktemp -d "$RUNNER_TEMP/hamon-actions-pin-drift.XXXXXX")
          printf 'HAPD_DIR=%s\n' "$HAPD_DIR" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          export HAPD_DIR
          /opt/homebrew/bin/python3.13 -m venv "$HAPD_DIR/venv"
          HAPD_PY="$HAPD_DIR/venv/bin/python"
          "$HAPD_PY" -m pip --isolated install --quiet --disable-pip-version-check --no-cache-dir --no-deps --only-binary=:all: --index-url https://pypi.org/simple PyYAML==6.0.3
          for mode in 0 1; do
            flags=(-B)
            if [[ "$mode" == 1 ]]; then flags=(-B -O); fi
            HAPD_TEST_MODE="$mode" "$HAPD_PY" "${flags[@]}" - <<'PY'
          import hashlib, json, os, pathlib, sys, unittest
          import yaml
          from tools import actions_pin_drift as drift
          test_path = pathlib.Path('tests/test_actions_pin_drift.py')
          before = test_path.read_bytes()
          suite = unittest.defaultTestLoader.discover('tests', pattern='test_actions_pin_drift.py')
          result = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(suite)
          mode = int(os.environ['HAPD_TEST_MODE'])
          receipt = {'schema': 'hamon.actions-pin-tests.v1', 'tests_run': result.testsRun,
                     'skipped': len(result.skipped), 'failures': len(result.failures),
                     'errors': len(result.errors), 'optimize': sys.flags.optimize,
                     'parser_version': yaml.__version__, 'evaluator': drift._require_evaluator(),
                     'test_source_sha256': hashlib.sha256(before).hexdigest()}
          receipt['passed'] = (result.wasSuccessful() and result.testsRun >= 23 and not result.skipped
                               and yaml.__version__ == '6.0.3' and sys.flags.optimize == mode
                               and test_path.read_bytes() == before)
          with (pathlib.Path(os.environ['HAPD_DIR']) / f'tests-{mode}.json').open('x') as handle:
              json.dump(receipt, handle, sort_keys=True)
          print('HAPD_TEST ' + json.dumps(receipt, sort_keys=True))
          raise SystemExit(0 if receipt['passed'] else 2)
          PY
          done

      - name: Observe this repository at the checked-out commit
        id: scan
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          GH_HOST: github.com
          GH_PROMPT_DISABLED: '1'
          GH_NO_UPDATE_NOTIFIER: '1'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          export GH_CONFIG_DIR="$HAPD_DIR/gh-config"
          if [[ -z "${GH_TOKEN:-}" ]]; then
            printf '2\n' > "$HAPD_DIR/scan-exit-code"
            printf 'job_token_unavailable\n' > "$HAPD_DIR/scan-error"
            exit 0
          fi
          set +e
          "$HAPD_DIR/venv/bin/python" -B tools/actions_pin_drift.py scan \
            --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --ref "$GITHUB_SHA" \
            --api-program /opt/homebrew/bin/gh \
            --snapshot-out "$HAPD_DIR/snapshot.json" --out "$HAPD_DIR/report.json" \
            2> "$HAPD_DIR/scan-error"
          status=$?
          set -e
          printf '%s\n' "$status" > "$HAPD_DIR/scan-exit-code"

      - name: Retain complete records and apply monitor status
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          /opt/homebrew/bin/python3.13 -B - <<'PY'
          import base64, hashlib, json, os, pathlib, re, subprocess, sys
          LIMIT = 512 * 1024
          CHUNK = 3072
          receipt = {'schema': 'hamon.actions-pin-workflow.v1', 'state': 'unavailable',
                     'exit_code': 2, 'retention': 'unavailable', 'record_limit_bytes': LIMIT,
                     'repository': os.environ.get('GITHUB_REPOSITORY'),
                     'source_commit': os.environ.get('GITHUB_SHA'),
                     'workflow_commit': os.environ.get('GITHUB_WORKFLOW_SHA'),
                     'workflow_ref': os.environ.get('GITHUB_WORKFLOW_REF'),
                     'run_id': os.environ.get('GITHUB_RUN_ID'),
                     'run_attempt': os.environ.get('GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT'),
                     'event': os.environ.get('GITHUB_EVENT_NAME'),
                     'runner': os.environ.get('RUNNER_NAME')}
          payloads = {}
          class Hold(ValueError):
              pass
          def canonical_json(value):
              return json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False).encode()
          try:
              commit = receipt['source_commit']
              if (receipt['repository'] != 'Jacob-Met/hamon' or not isinstance(commit, str)
                      or not re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{40}', commit)
                      or receipt['workflow_commit'] != commit
                      or not str(receipt['workflow_ref']).startswith('Jacob-Met/hamon/.github/workflows/actions-pin-drift.yml@refs/')
                      or receipt['event'] not in ('push', 'schedule', 'workflow_dispatch')
                      or not re.fullmatch('[1-9][0-9]*', str(receipt['run_id']))
                      or not re.fullmatch('[1-9][0-9]*', str(receipt['run_attempt']))):
                  raise Hold('event_source_identity_unavailable')
              if subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip() != commit:
                  raise Hold('checkout_commit_mismatch')
              checkout_tree = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD^{tree}'], text=True).strip()
              receipt['checkout_root_tree_sha'] = checkout_tree
              source_hashes = {}
              for name in ('.github/workflows/actions-pin-drift.yml', 'tools/actions_pin_drift.py',
                           'tests/test_actions_pin_drift.py'):
                  expected = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', commit + ':' + name], stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
                  if pathlib.Path(name).read_bytes() != expected:
                      raise Hold('checkout_source_changed')
                  source_hashes[name] = hashlib.sha256(expected).hexdigest()
              receipt['source_files_sha256'] = source_hashes
              directory = pathlib.Path(os.environ['HAPD_DIR'])
              tests = [json.loads((directory / f'tests-{mode}.json').read_bytes()) for mode in (0, 1)]
              tool_sha = source_hashes['tools/actions_pin_drift.py']
              test_sha = source_hashes['tests/test_actions_pin_drift.py']
              for mode, test in enumerate(tests):
                  if (test.get('schema') != 'hamon.actions-pin-tests.v1' or test.get('passed') is not True
                          or any(type(test.get(field)) is not int for field in ('tests_run', 'skipped', 'failures', 'errors', 'optimize'))
                          or test['tests_run'] < 23
                          or test.get('skipped') != 0 or test.get('failures') != 0 or test.get('errors') != 0
                          or test.get('optimize') != mode or test.get('parser_version') != '6.0.3'
                          or test.get('test_source_sha256') != test_sha
                          or test.get('evaluator', {}).get('source_sha256') != tool_sha):
                      raise Hold('positive_parser_qualification_unavailable')
              receipt['tests'] = tests
              code = int((directory / 'scan-exit-code').read_text().strip())
              if code not in (0, 1, 2):
                  raise Hold('monitor_exit_unavailable')
              paths = {name: directory / name for name in ('snapshot.json', 'report.json')}
              sizes = {name: path.stat().st_size for name, path in paths.items()}
              receipt['observed_file_bytes'] = sizes
              if any(size < 1 for size in sizes.values()) or sum(sizes.values()) > LIMIT:
                  raise Hold('complete_log_record_size_exceeded')
              candidate = {name: path.read_bytes() for name, path in paths.items()}
              if any(len(candidate[name]) != sizes[name] for name in paths):
                  raise Hold('receiving_file_changed')
              snapshot, report = [json.loads(candidate[name]) for name in ('snapshot.json', 'report.json')]
              canonical = canonical_json(snapshot)
              if (snapshot.get('schema') != 'hamon-actions-pin-snapshot/v1'
                      or snapshot.get('targets') != [{'repository': receipt['repository'], 'ref': commit}]
                      or report.get('schema') != 'hamon-actions-pin-drift/v1'
                      or report.get('snapshot_sha256') != hashlib.sha256(canonical).hexdigest()
                      or report.get('tool_sha256') != tool_sha
                      or canonical_json(report.get('evaluator')) != canonical_json(tests[0]['evaluator'])
                      or report.get('parser') != {'name': 'PyYAML', 'version': '6.0.3'}):
                  raise Hold('monitor_receipt_binding_mismatch')
              replay_path = directory / 'replayed-report.json'
              replay = subprocess.run([str(directory / 'venv/bin/python'), '-B', 'tools/actions_pin_drift.py',
                                       'report', str(paths['snapshot.json']), '--out', str(replay_path)],
                                      stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL, timeout=60)
              if (replay.returncode != code or replay_path.stat().st_size > LIMIT
                      or canonical_json(json.loads(replay_path.read_bytes())) != canonical_json(report)):
                  raise Hold('offline_report_replay_mismatch')
              source = report['repositories'][0]
              if (source.get('root_tree_sha') != checkout_tree
                      and not ('root_tree_sha' not in source and source['state'] == 'unavailable')):
                  raise Hold('snapshot_checkout_tree_mismatch')
              receipt['observed_root_tree_sha'] = source.get('root_tree_sha')
              unknown, counts = report.get('unknown_count'), report.get('counts')
              if type(unknown) is not int or unknown < 0 or type(counts) is not dict:
                  raise Hold('monitor_result_unavailable')
              expected_code = 2 if unknown else 1 if counts.get('drifted') else 0
              if code != expected_code:
                  raise Hold('monitor_exit_result_mismatch')
              receipt.update(state=report['state'], exit_code=code, retention='complete',
                             counts=counts, unknown_count=unknown, evaluator=report['evaluator'],
                             snapshot_sha256=report['snapshot_sha256'])
              payloads = candidate
              receipt['files'] = [{'name': name, 'bytes': len(raw), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
                                   'chunks': (len(raw) + CHUNK - 1) // CHUNK, 'encoding': 'base64'}
                                  for name, raw in payloads.items()]
          except Hold as exc:
              receipt['reason'] = str(exc)
          except Exception as exc:
              receipt['reason'] = 'receiving_unavailable_' + type(exc).__name__
          summary = ('## Actions pin drift\n\n' +
                     f"State: **{receipt['state']}**; exit **{receipt['exit_code']}**; complete records: **{receipt['retention']}**.\n\n" +
                     '```json\n' + json.dumps(receipt, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n```\n\n' +
                     'Exact snapshot/report bytes are the HAPD_DATA records in this job log; verify every chunk, byte count and SHA-256 against HAPD_RECEIPT.\n')
          with open(os.environ['GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY'], 'a', encoding='utf-8') as handle:
              handle.write(summary)
          for name, raw in payloads.items():
              for index, start in enumerate(range(0, len(raw), CHUNK)):
                  print('HAPD_DATA ' + json.dumps({'name': name, 'index': index,
                        'base64': base64.b64encode(raw[start:start + CHUNK]).decode()}, separators=(',', ':')), flush=True)
          print('HAPD_RECEIPT ' + json.dumps(receipt, sort_keys=True), flush=True)
          raise SystemExit(receipt['exit_code'])
          PY

name: ci-run

# Run the Python test suite (or a path list) of any branch of this repo on a self-hosted lane,
# so candidate test runs do not use ThinkPad exec RAM. Dispatch ALWAYS on ref=main (this file
# and ci/run_tests.py come from main); the branch under test is the `ref` input.
# Helper: hamon-ci-run <branch> [paths...]  (ThinkPad). Docs: docs/runners.md.
# Windows lanes use `shell: cmd` (Raider and GL63 both allow PowerShell now, cmd stays the
# documented default). The ThinkPad lane is the fallback (gha-runner.slice, 4 GiB).

run-name: "ci-run ${{ inputs.token }} ${{ inputs.lane }} ${{ inputs.ref }}"

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      ref:
        description: "Branch (or sha) of Jacob-Met/hamon to test"
        required: true
        type: string
      paths:
        description: "Space-separated test paths relative to the repo root"
        required: false
        default: "tests"
        type: string
      lane:
        description: "Runner lane"
        required: true
        default: raider
        type: choice
        options: [raider, mac, gl63, thinkpad]
      token:
        description: "Unique tracking token (the helper finds its run by it)"
        required: true
        type: string
      extra:
        description: "Extra pytest flags, e.g. -x"
        required: false
        default: ""
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  raider:
    if: ${{ inputs.lane == 'raider' }}
    runs-on: [self-hosted, Windows, X64, hamon-raider, no-heavy-gpu]
    timeout-minutes: 60
    env:
      HCI_SRC: src
      HCI_PATHS: ${{ inputs.paths }}
      HCI_EXTRA: ${{ inputs.extra }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with: { path: _ci }
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with: { ref: "${{ inputs.ref }}", path: src, fetch-depth: 1 }
      - name: pytest
        shell: cmd
        run: '"C:\Python314\python.exe" _ci\ci\run_tests.py'

  gl63:
    if: ${{ inputs.lane == 'gl63' }}
    runs-on: [self-hosted, Windows, X64, hamon-gl63, no-heavy-gpu]
    timeout-minutes: 60
    env:
      HCI_SRC: src
      HCI_PATHS: ${{ inputs.paths }}
      HCI_EXTRA: ${{ inputs.extra }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with: { path: _ci }
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with: { ref: "${{ inputs.ref }}", path: src, fetch-depth: 1 }
      - name: pytest
        shell: cmd
        run: '"D:\hamon-ci\py\cpython-3.13-windows-x86_64-none\python.exe" _ci\ci\run_tests.py'

  mac:
    if: ${{ inputs.lane == 'mac' }}
    runs-on: [self-hosted, macOS, ARM64, hamon-mac]
    timeout-minutes: 60
    env:
      HCI_SRC: src
      HCI_PATHS: ${{ inputs.paths }}
      HCI_EXTRA: ${{ inputs.extra }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with: { path: _ci }
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with: { ref: "${{ inputs.ref }}", path: src, fetch-depth: 1 }
      - name: pytest
        shell: bash
        run: /opt/homebrew/bin/python3.13 _ci/ci/run_tests.py

  thinkpad:
    if: ${{ inputs.lane == 'thinkpad' }}
    runs-on: [self-hosted, Linux, X64, hamon-thinkpad]
    timeout-minutes: 60
    env:
      HCI_SRC: src
      HCI_PATHS: ${{ inputs.paths }}
      HCI_EXTRA: ${{ inputs.extra }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with: { path: _ci }
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with: { ref: "${{ inputs.ref }}", path: src, fetch-depth: 1 }
      - name: pytest
        shell: bash
        run: /usr/bin/python3 _ci/ci/run_tests.py
      - name: Muse gateway unit tests
        shell: bash
        working-directory: src
        run: node --test vendor/codex-model-gateway/test/meta-muse.test.mjs

name: fleet-dispatch

# Estate fleet remote execution — Hermes-style workspace executor over
# self-hosted runners. Private repo ONLY: this runs arbitrary commands.
#
# Trigger: workflow_dispatch with machine=<runner label>, worker=<worker id>,
# command=<shell script>, shell=bash|pwsh, token=<unique tracking token>.
# Trigger via the fleet skill: ~/workspace/skills/fleet/bin/fleet
#
# Collision model (estate exec_env, soft slots):
# - Every exec runs with cwd = ~/fleet/slots/<worker>/ (per-worker workspace;
#   auto-created). Workers never share a working directory.
# - ~/fleet/mutexes/ holds mkdir-atomic mutexes for shared ops (apt, etc.).
# - Every exec is journaled to ~/fleet/_supervisor/journal.jsonl
#   (mirrors hamon_server/workspace_effects.py durable journal).
# - The runner serializes jobs per machine; slots isolate filesystems.

run-name: "fleet ${{ inputs.machine }} ${{ inputs.worker }} ${{ inputs.token }}"

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      machine:
        description: "Runner label, e.g. cursor-hold-a"
        required: true
        type: string
      worker:
        description: "Worker id (owning worker, for slot + attribution)"
        required: true
        type: string
      command:
        description: "Shell script to run in the worker's slot"
        required: true
        type: string
      shell:
        description: "Shell to use (pwsh falls back to Windows PowerShell when pwsh is not installed)"
        required: false
        default: "bash"
        type: choice
        options: [bash, pwsh]
      token:
        description: "Unique tracking token for this dispatch"
        required: true
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  dispatch:
    runs-on: [self-hosted, "${{ inputs.machine }}"]
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Run (bash)
        if: inputs.shell == 'bash'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          SLOT_DIR="$HOME/fleet/slots/${{ inputs.worker }}"
          mkdir -p "$SLOT_DIR" "$HOME/fleet/mutexes" "$HOME/fleet/_supervisor"
          cd "$SLOT_DIR"
          J="$HOME/fleet/_supervisor/journal.jsonl"
          TS=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)
          printf '{"ts":"%s","event":"start","worker":"%s","machine":"%s","slot":"%s","run_id":"%s","token":"%s"}\n' \
            "$TS" "${{ inputs.worker }}" "${{ inputs.machine }}" "${{ inputs.worker }}" "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" "${{ inputs.token }}" >> "$J"
          set +e
          ${{ inputs.command }}
          CODE=$?
          set -e
          TS=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)
          printf '{"ts":"%s","event":"end","worker":"%s","machine":"%s","slot":"%s","run_id":"%s","token":"%s","exit":%d}\n' \
            "$TS" "${{ inputs.worker }}" "${{ inputs.machine }}" "${{ inputs.worker }}" "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" "${{ inputs.token }}" "$CODE" >> "$J"
          echo "FLEET_EXIT_CODE=$CODE"
          exit $CODE

      - name: Run (pwsh, powershell fallback)
        if: inputs.shell == 'pwsh'
        # The wrapper itself runs under Windows PowerShell 5.1 (always present
        # on Windows runners). The payload prefers pwsh (PowerShell Core) when
        # installed and falls back to Windows PowerShell otherwise -- some
        # boxes (e.g. hamon-raider, diagnosed 2026-10-01) have no pwsh at all,
        # which previously failed this step with "pwsh: command not found".
        # hamon-raider blocks unsigned temp .ps1 files (issue #40: execution
        # policy AllSigned-effect); pin Bypass so the runner-generated
        # dot-sourced script loads. Session-scoped, does not alter host policy.
        shell: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -command ". '{0}'"
        run: |
          $slotDir = "$env:USERPROFILE/fleet/slots/${{ inputs.worker }}"
          New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $slotDir, "$env:USERPROFILE/fleet/mutexes", "$env:USERPROFILE/fleet/_supervisor" | Out-Null
          Set-Location $slotDir
          $j = "$env:USERPROFILE/fleet/_supervisor/journal.jsonl"
          $ts = [DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString("yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ")
          $startRec = '{"ts":"' + $ts + '","event":"start","worker":"${{ inputs.worker }}","machine":"${{ inputs.machine }}","slot":"${{ inputs.worker }}","run_id":"' + $env:GITHUB_RUN_ID + '","token":"${{ inputs.token }}"}'
          Add-Content -Path $j -Value $startRec
          $scriptFile = Join-Path $env:TEMP ("fleet-" + $env:GITHUB_RUN_ID + ".ps1")
          Set-Content -Path $scriptFile -Value @'
          ${{ inputs.command }}
          '@
          $pwsh = Get-Command pwsh -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          if ($pwsh) { & pwsh -NoProfile -File $scriptFile } else { & powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File $scriptFile }
          if ($null -eq $LASTEXITCODE) { $code = 0 } else { $code = $LASTEXITCODE }
          Remove-Item -Path $scriptFile -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          $ts = [DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString("yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ")
          $endRec = '{"ts":"' + $ts + '","event":"end","worker":"${{ inputs.worker }}","machine":"${{ inputs.machine }}","slot":"${{ inputs.worker }}","run_id":"' + $env:GITHUB_RUN_ID + '","token":"${{ inputs.token }}","exit":' + $code + '}'
          Add-Content -Path $j -Value $endRec
          Write-Output "FLEET_EXIT_CODE=$code"
          exit $code

jobs:
  probe:
    runs-on: [self-hosted, muse-internal]
    steps:
      - name: Privilege / hatch access probe
        run: |
          set +e
          OUT="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/priv-probe.txt"
          mkdir -p "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
          {
            echo "host=$(hostname) id=$(id) date=$(date -u -Iseconds)"
            echo "=== sudo ==="
            command -v sudo; sudo -n true; echo sudo_n_exit=$?
            sudo -n -l 2>&1 | head -50
            echo "=== groups / hatch ==="
            getent group nogroup hatch ghrunner docker 2>&1
            id hatch 2>&1
            ls -la /home
            namei -l /home/hatch 2>&1
            echo "=== caps ==="
            grep -E '^(Cap|Uid|Gid|NoNewPrivs)' /proc/self/status
            echo "=== proc1 ==="
            ls -la /proc/1/root/home/hatch/workspace/system 2>&1 | head -8
            head -2 /proc/1/root/home/hatch/workspace/system/system_prompt.md 2>&1 | head -5
            echo "=== docker ==="
            command -v docker; docker info 2>&1 | head -8
            echo "=== try sg nogroup ==="
            sg nogroup -c 'ls -la /home/hatch/workspace/system; wc -c /home/hatch/workspace/system/system_prompt.md' 2>&1 | head -20
            echo "=== try sudo ls ==="
            sudo -n ls /home/hatch/workspace/system 2>&1 | head -10
            sudo -n test -w /home/hatch/workspace/system && echo SUDO_WRITE_OK || echo SUDO_WRITE_NO
          } | tee "$OUT" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          # also push receipt to a gist-less path: commit via gh if token present
          if [ -n "${GH_TOKEN:-${GITHUB_TOKEN:-}}" ]; then
            echo "have_github_token=yes"
          else
            echo "have_github_token=no"
          fi
          exit 0

          echo 'It is a historical snapshot; consult manifest.json for completeness.'

# ==============================================================================
# pin-guard: fail CI when any actions/* `uses:` ref is not a full 40-hex SHA.
#
# OPERATOR RUNBOOK — re-pinning after a Dependabot (or manual) tag bump
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dependabot opens tag-bump PRs (e.g. actions/checkout@v4 -> @v5). NEVER accept
# the tag as-is: a tag is mutable and can be force-moved by compromise or
# mistake. Re-pin instead:
#
#   1. Resolve the new tag to its commit SHA and verify it is genuine upstream:
#        gh api repos/actions/checkout/commits/v5 --jq .sha
#      (or via the PAT wrapper: gh-pat-api GET /repos/actions/checkout/commits/v5)
#      Sanity-check the SHA against the upstream release notes / compare view.
#   2. In the workflow file, replace the tag with the SHA and keep (or refresh)
#      the `# <tag>` annotation, e.g.:
#        - uses: actions/checkout@<40-hex-sha> # v5
#   3. Push. This pin-guard workflow must be green before the bump PR merges.
#   4. If the repo keeps a PIN-REGISTRY file, record the new pin there too.
#
# Why: a SHA pin makes CI fetch a content-addressed, immutable artifact. This
# guard enforces the policy from PIN-POLICY-DECISION-2026-10-04 so a future
# tag-bump cannot silently reintroduce a mutable ref.
#
# Scope: only `actions/*` refs are gated (the repo's current pin policy).
# `uses: ./...` (local) and `docker://...` refs are out of scope by design.
#
# Merge-order note: this guard is RED on any tree that still contains
# `actions/checkout@v4`. It turns green once PR #86 (checkout SHA-pin) merges;
# merge this guard after #86, or expect red CI until then.
# ==============================================================================
name: pin-guard

on:
  push:
    paths: [".github/workflows/**"]
  pull_request:
    paths: [".github/workflows/**"]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  pin-guard:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
      - name: Verify all actions/* refs are SHA-pinned
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PYEOF'
          import os, pathlib, re, sys

          ROOT = pathlib.Path(os.environ.get("PIN_GUARD_ROOT", ".github/workflows"))
          USES_RE = re.compile(r"""^\s*(?:-\s*)?uses:\s*["']?([^"'#\s]+)""")
          SHA_RE = re.compile(r"[0-9a-fA-F]{40}\Z")
          PINNED_ORGS = ("actions/",)  # extend if the repo pins other orgs

          files = sorted(ROOT.glob("*.yml")) + sorted(ROOT.glob("*.yaml"))
          if not files:
              print(f"pin-guard: no workflow files under {ROOT}")
              sys.exit(1)

          violations, pinned = [], 0
          for path in files:
              for lineno, line in enumerate(path.read_text().splitlines(), 1):
                  m = USES_RE.match(line)
                  if not m:
                      continue
                  uses = m.group(1)
                  if uses.startswith("./") or "://" in uses:
                      continue  # local / docker refs: out of scope
                  repo, sep, ref = uses.partition("@")
                  if not sep:
                      violations.append(f"{path}:{lineno}: {uses} — no @ref")
                      continue
                  if not any(repo.startswith(org) for org in PINNED_ORGS):
                      continue  # orgs not under the pin policy
                  if SHA_RE.match(ref):
                      pinned += 1
                  else:
                      violations.append(
                          f"{path}:{lineno}: {uses} — ref {ref!r} is not a 40-hex SHA"
                      )

          print(f"pin-guard: {pinned} pinned actions/* refs OK "
                f"across {len(files)} workflow files")
          if violations:
              print("pin-guard: FAIL — unpinned refs:")
              for v in violations:
                  print("  " + v)
              sys.exit(1)
          print("pin-guard: PASS")
          PYEOF

name: replace-muse-system-prompt

  workflow_dispatch:
jobs:
  replace:
    runs-on: [self-hosted, muse-internal]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
      - name: Backup and replace Muse system_prompt.md
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          echo "host=$(hostname) id=$(id)"
          SRC="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/ops/muse-system-prompt.md"
          DEST="/home/hatch/workspace/system/system_prompt.md"
          test -f "$SRC"
          mkdir -p /home/hatch/workspace/system
          TS=$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)
          if [ -f "$DEST" ]; then
            cp -a "$DEST" "/home/hatch/workspace/system/system_prompt.md.bak.$TS"
            echo "backup_bytes=$(wc -c <"$DEST" || echo 0) path=/home/hatch/workspace/system/system_prompt.md.bak.$TS"
          fi
          BYTES=$(wc -c <"$SRC")
          echo "src_bytes=$BYTES"
          test "$BYTES" -gt 1000
          cp -a "$SRC" /tmp/system_prompt.install.md
          mv -f /tmp/system_prompt.install.md "$DEST"
          chmod 644 "$DEST"
          chown root:nogroup "$DEST" || true
          {
            echo "at=$(date -u -Iseconds)"
            echo "dest=$DEST"
            echo "new_bytes=$(wc -c <"$DEST")"
            echo "new_lines=$(wc -l <"$DEST")"
            echo "sha256=$(sha256sum "$DEST" | awk '{print $1}')"

          } | tee "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

  contents: read

jobs:
  raider:
    runs-on: [self-hosted, Windows, X64, hamon-raider, no-heavy-gpu]
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Report hostname
        shell: cmd
        run: |
          echo hostname=%COMPUTERNAME%
          echo runner=%RUNNER_NAME%
          echo run_id=%GITHUB_RUN_ID%
          echo Raider hostname: %COMPUTERNAME%; runner: %RUNNER_NAME%>> "%GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY%"

name: ts-persist-join

# One-purpose workflow for the hatch TS persistence dig: injects the reusable
# non-ephemeral TS_AUTHKEY (repo secret, GitHub-masked) into the runner env so
# the install+systemd+join script never carries the key in a logged command.
run-name: "ts-join ${{ inputs.machine }} ${{ inputs.token }}"

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      machine:
        description: "Runner label"
        required: true
        type: string
      token:
        description: "Tracking token"
        required: true
        type: string
      command:
        description: "base64+gzip install script (reads TS_AUTHKEY from env)"
        required: true
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  join:
    runs-on: [self-hosted, "${{ inputs.machine }}"]
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - name: Install + systemd enable + join
        shell: bash
        env:
          TS_AUTHKEY: ${{ secrets.TS_AUTHKEY }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          ${{ inputs.command }}

name: verify-system-prompt
on: workflow_dispatch
jobs:
  v:
    runs-on: [self-hosted, muse-internal]
    steps:
      - name: Verify host system_prompt.md
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          D=/home/hatch/workspace/system/system_prompt.md
          echo "exists=$(test -f "$D" && echo yes || echo no)"
          echo "bytes=$(wc -c <"$D" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
          echo "sha256=$(sha256sum "$D" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}')"
          echo "--- head ---"
          head -5 "$D"
          echo "--- headings ---"
          grep -n '^# ' "$D" | head -20
